resources.string: Fixes commonly confused words (their/there, its/it\'s, a/an, he go → he goes) in the sentence you\'re typing. Skips Roman Urdu sentences.
High-confidence fixes are applied automatically; press backspace right after to undo. Other fixes are underlined, tap the word to see the fix.
See and control what the keyboard learned from your typing
Use the text you\'ve already typed
Gives Whisper models the text before the cursor as context, for better names, punctuation and casing. Never used in password fields.
Use the GPU for voice input
Experimental. Runs the speech model on the phone\'s GPU (Vulkan). If voice input crashes it switches back to the CPU automatically. Turn this off again if transcripts look wrong or it\'s slower.
